class.name: JRPGMap
class.brief_description: The root node of a JRPG map scene.
class.description: Holds the map's [JRPGMapData] as a built-in resource of the scene, so the map's edits follow the scene's undo history and save with it, and draws it: for each tile layer, two internal [TileMapLayer] nodes hold the tiles drawn below characters and the overhead tiles drawn above them. Autotile and wall cells show the shape [JRPGAutotileResolver] picks from their neighbors. The map's quarter shadows ([member JRPGMapData.shadows]) are drawn half-opaque over the ground layers and under the objects. Any other node can be added under the map.

method.name: get_cell_size
method.description: Returns the size of one map cell in the map's local coordinates: the tile size of the [TileSet] the map draws with, or [constant DEFAULT_CELL_SIZE] pixels on each side when it has none yet.

method.name: get_database
method.description: Returns the database the map's tileset comes from: the one given with [method set_database], or else the project's ([code]res://jrpg/database.tres[/code]).

method.name: get_rebuild_count
method.description: Returns how many times the map was drawn in full (for diagnostics: painting cells must not cause it).

method.name: get_tile_layer
method.description: Returns the internal [TileMapLayer] that draws [param layer]'s tiles below characters, or above them when [param above] is [code]true[/code] (tiles whose baked flags say overhead).

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Draws every cell again. The map does this by itself when its size, tileset or arrays change, or when its tileset's palette or baked flags change; a paint only redraws the cells around it.

method.name: set_database
method.description: Draws the map with [param database]'s tilesets instead of the project's (tests and tools).

constants.constant: The z index of tiles drawn below characters.
The z index of overhead tiles, drawn above characters.
The cell size, in pixels, of a map whose tileset has no [TileSet] yet.
